checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face and pose look identical to the original.

must.item: Curly hair and sweater preserved with clean edges
must.why: Hair curls and sweater texture are intact. Edges look natural, with only a slight halo.

must.item: Sand and blue sea replace park
must.why: Blue sky, turquoise surf, sand and palms replace the park.
Lighting is mostly coherent, but the background is saturated and the subject looks slightly flat against it.

faults.what: Background is oversaturated and HDR-like, so it looks slightly different in tone from the subject. Hair edges show a faint cutout feel.
A dark object on the right edge (driftwood or debris) looks odd.

summary: The park was replaced with a convincing beach and the subject is unchanged. The only issues are a slightly oversaturated background and a faint cutout look at the hair edges.
